# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 37 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37-38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_037_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 37

**1** His disciples said: "When will you be revealed to us and when will we see you?"

**2** Jesus said: "When you strip without being ashamed, take your garments, place them under your feet like little children, and trample on them —

**3** then you will see the Son of the Living One and you will not be afraid."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- The question is eschatological; the answer is ethical/ascetic
- "Strip without being ashamed" — the shameless nudity of paradise (cf. Gen 2:25: "naked and not ashamed")
- "Trample on them" — the garments (social identity, bodily shame) are actively defeated
- "Like little children" — the child motif (Sayings 4, 21, 22); the child's unselfconscious state
- "Son of the Living One" — the revelation is of the divine Christ; the reward is vision and fearlessness
